Class ResponsiveLayout

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.ResponsiveLayout
public class ResponsiveLayout extends Object
Installs the game screen's responsive behaviour: a uniform letterbox scale of the content over a reference resolution, the centred board wrapper, and the cover-style background that fills the window while preserving ratio.

Created and installed once from GameViewController.initialize().

    • applyUiScale

      private void applyUiScale(javafx.scene.transform.Scale scale)
      Computes the uniform (letterbox) scale factor and centers contentPane in root. The Scale pivot is (0,0); the translate compensates for the difference between root and the scaled contentPane.
